[GOOS:windows] skip 'logos conc needs named pipes'
[GOOS:plan9] skip 'logos conc needs named pipes'

env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

# Review output, the text findings and the --ai-patch brief, goes to
# standard output. Diagnostic records of --json-diagnostics go to
# standard error. The child stalls on a Done-channel receive, so each
# run has one finding and one brief.
cd streams

# Plain: the test result, the text finding and the brief share standard
# output, and standard error stays empty.
! logos conc test -stall=200ms -count=1 --ai-patch ./stalled
stdout '^ok '
stdout '^.*stalled[/\\]main\.lgo:17: \[conc::group_child_stalled\] '
stdout '^\t.*main\.lgo:24: the group started this child here$'
stdout '^\tfix: '
stdout '^\{"file":".*main\.lgo","line":17,"edit":'
! stderr .

# --json-diagnostics: the record goes to standard error, and the brief
# stays a plain JSON object on standard output, which is no test2json
# stream here.
! logos conc test -stall=200ms -count=1 --ai-patch --json-diagnostics ./stalled
stdout '^ok '
stdout '^\{"file":".*main\.lgo","line":17,"edit":'
! stdout '"Action"'
! stdout 'conc::'
stderr '^\{"schema_version":"1\.0","severity":"deny","rule_id":"conc::group_child_stalled","file":".*main\.lgo","span":\{"start_line":17,'
stderr -count=1 '^\{"schema_version"'
! stderr '^\t'
! stderr '"edit"'

# test -json: standard output is the test2json stream, so the text
# finding and the brief each ride in output events, and every line of
# standard output is a JSON object.
! logos conc test -stall=200ms -count=1 --ai-patch -json ./stalled
stdout '"Action":"pass","Package":"example\.com/concstreams/stalled","Elapsed"'
stdout '^\{"Action":"output","Output":".*main\.lgo:17: \[conc::group_child_stalled\] '
stdout '^\{"Action":"output","Output":"\\tfix: '
stdout '^\{"Action":"output","Output":"\{\\"file\\":\\".*main\.lgo\\",\\"line\\":17,\\"edit\\":'
! stdout '^\{"file"'
! stdout '^[^{]'
! stderr .

# Both: the record goes to standard error, and the brief rides in an
# output event of the test2json stream on standard output.
! logos conc test -stall=200ms -count=1 --ai-patch -json --json-diagnostics ./stalled
stdout '"Action":"pass","Package":"example\.com/concstreams/stalled","Elapsed"'
stdout '^\{"Action":"output","Output":"\{\\"file\\":\\".*main\.lgo\\",\\"line\\":17,\\"edit\\":'
! stdout 'conc::'
! stdout '^\{"file"'
! stdout '^[^{]'
stderr '^\{"schema_version":"1\.0","severity":"deny","rule_id":"conc::group_child_stalled",'
stderr -count=1 '^\{"schema_version"'
! stderr '"edit"'

# GOFLAGS=-json makes the same test2json stream.
env GOFLAGS=-json
! logos conc test -stall=200ms -count=1 ./stalled
stdout '^\{"Action":"output","Output":".*main\.lgo:17: \[conc::group_child_stalled\] '
! stdout '^[^{]'
! stderr .
env GOFLAGS=

# run: the text finding shares standard output with the program.
! logos conc run -stall=200ms ./stalled
stdout '^jobs done: first job failed$'
stdout '^.*stalled[/\\]main\.lgo:17: \[conc::group_child_stalled\] '
! stderr .

-- streams/go.mod --
module example.com/concstreams

go 1.27
-- streams/stalled/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"time"
)

func fail() error {
	return errors.New("first job failed")
}

func slow(ctx context.Context) error {
	inner, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 1500*time.Millisecond)
	defer cancel()
	<-inner.Done()
	return nil
}

func jobs(ctx context.Context) error {
	go group (ctx) {
		go fail()
		go slow(ctx)
	}
	return nil
}

func main() {
	fmt.Println("jobs done:", jobs(context.Background()))
}
-- streams/stalled/main_test.lgo --
package main

import "testing"

func TestJobs(t *testing.T) {
	if err := jobs(t.Context()); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("the first job did not fail the group")
	}
}
